peer.rule: same class ({class}), market segment ({segment}) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer
peer.priceBand.above: Higher relative price than most peers
peer.priceBand.below: Lower relative price than most peers
yield.caption: Gross yield = 12 x typical rent / typical resale price for the same size band. Before maintenance, property tax, vacancy and agent fees. Not a return on your cash.
yield.peers: same class, market segment and 100 sq ft size band; original lease 99 years or longer, including freehold and 999-year (short leases excluded)
yield.range: the range from combining the middle half of rents with the middle half of prices (12 x lower-quartile rent / upper-quartile price to 12 x upper-quartile rent / lower-quartile price); not a confidence interval
yield.shortLease: Developments with leases under 99 years are excluded from standard long-lease peer groups.
yield.position.near: near the peer median (its range includes it)
income.geography: {planningArea} planning area (Master Plan 2019), not a postal district.
income.definition: Income is household employment income including employer CPF.
income.context: This describes the area, not buyers.
income.attribution: SingStat, General Household Survey 2025, table C020145 (resident households by planning area and monthly household employment income)
income.conditions: Employment income includes employer CPF and platform-worker CPF contributions
Figures are rounded to the nearest 100 and may not add up
Small cells should be read with caution
